guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile build fails on the step 'RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs && npm install -g npm@latest' due to an npm engine incompatibility error. The log states: 'npm error code EBADENGINE' and 'npm error engine Not compatible with your version of node/npm: npm@12.2.2'. It further states the required node version is '^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0' but the actual installed Node.js version is 'v18.20.8'. This suggests that Node.js 18.x is deprecated and incompatible with the required npm version (12.2.2). 

Recommended fix: Upgrade the Node.js version in the Dockerfile to a currently supported version that meets the npm requirements. For example, use Node.js 22.x, 24.x, or later. Adjust the setup URL accordingly (e.g., https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x) and ensure all commands reflect this upgrade. This will resolve the incompatibility and allow npm to install properly, enabling a successful Docker build.
